plugins.name: webex-connect-ai
plugins.description: Webex Connect skills for tenant setup, digital-channel messaging, asset management, webhooks, and SDK app development.

skills.name: webex-connect-setup
skills.description: Configure Webex Connect Sandbox or Production tenant access, regional API endpoints, credentials, Digital Asset API prerequisites, and the region-matched Production SMS/Email MCP in a local .env or secure MCP host. Use before API-backed workflows when setup is missing or incomplete; SDK app and widget builders do not require this setup.

skills.name: webexconnect-android-push-inapp-messaging-builder
skills.description: Build or repair native Android apps that use the Webex Connect SDK for Push Notifications or In-App Messaging, including registration, chat, notifications, and QA.

skills.name: webexconnect-apple-messages-for-business-sendmessage
skills.description: Build and validate Webex Connect Apple Messages for Business API v1 requests for text, rich messages, attachments, callbacks, and delivery handling.

skills.name: webexconnect-contact-policy
skills.description: Use Webex Connect Contact Policy APIs to manage consent, opt-in and opt-out, channel checks, frequency caps, and message policy enforcement.

skills.name: webexconnect-digital-asset-creation
skills.description: Create, retrieve, and update Webex Connect Chat, Email, Facebook Messenger, or WhatsApp digital assets using the documented operation schema, tenant-region routing, and confirmation before mutations.

skills.name: webexconnect-email-sendmessage
skills.description: Build, validate, or send Webex Connect Email through Send Message API v2 or the configured Email MCP, including sender discovery, recipients, content, callbacks, and receipts.

skills.name: webexconnect-facebook-messenger-sendmessage
skills.description: Build and validate Webex Connect Facebook Messenger API v1 messages for Page-scoped recipients, text, attachments, interactive replies, and callbacks.

skills.name: webexconnect-ios-push-inapp-messaging-builder
skills.description: Build or repair native iOS apps that use the Webex Connect SDK for Push Notifications or In-App Messaging, including registration, chat, notifications, and QA.

skills.name: webexconnect-livechat-inapp-sendmessage
skills.description: Build and validate Webex Connect Messaging API v1 requests for Live Chat, In-App Messaging, notifications, threads, and callbacks.

skills.name: webexconnect-livechat-widget
skills.description: Build or troubleshoot a browser Live Chat widget using the Webex Connect JavaScript SDK, including setup, registration, threads, messaging, and events.

skills.name: webexconnect-mms-sendmessage
skills.description: Build and validate Webex Connect MMS Send Message API v2 requests for recipients, attachments, fallback text, receipts, and callbacks.

skills.name: webexconnect-push-sendmessage
skills.description: Build and validate Webex Connect Push Messaging API v1 requests for registered users and devices, platform payloads, notifications, and callbacks.

skills.name: webexconnect-rcs-sendmessage
skills.description: Build and validate Webex Connect RCS Send Message API v2 requests for capability checks, rich content, templates, and SMS fallback.

skills.name: webexconnect-sandbox
skills.description: Configure and use the Webex Connect Sandbox for supported SMS, Voice, or WhatsApp API tests, verified recipients, and sandbox-specific limits.

skills.name: webexconnect-sendmessage
skills.description: Route an outbound Webex Connect message to the correct channel skill and API family, using shared setup, Contact Policy, and webhook guidance when required.

skills.name: webexconnect-sms-sendmessage
skills.description: Build, validate, or send Webex Connect SMS through Send Message API v2 or the configured SMS MCP, including sender discovery, recipients, scheduling, receipts, and callbacks.

skills.name: webexconnect-voice-sendmessage
skills.description: Build and validate Webex Connect Voice API v1 and documented Send Message API v2 voice requests for outbound calls, text-to-speech, media, callbacks, and call status.

skills.name: webexconnect-webhooks-events
skills.description: Build and troubleshoot Webex Connect webhook receivers, callback verification, inbound events, Event API requests, retries, and data streams.

skills.name: webexconnect-whatsapp-sendmessage
skills.description: Build and validate Webex Connect WhatsApp API v1 messages for session replies, approved templates, media, interactive content, and callbacks.
